control_scope: unrelated sham can compete for attention; not a mathematical zero; ZERO replay measures hydration noise separately
deviations: No GPU snapshots exist in sandbox; recipes are not snapshots.
Controlled direct _attempt after chronological fact feeds; not a natural routed full-battery serving receipt.
Mask exclusion replaces physical deletion to preserve all other row positions.
E2E-derived recipes retain completed fact turns; filler and previous generated probes are not replayed.
evidence_class: reasoning; preregistration before any CPU/GPU gate
fixture_phase: freeze 20 recipes now; lead captures 20 actual model states before fork gates, in four cells of five. Actual strata are pending.
fork_contract: remove/sham disable only target columns in canonical attention masks (no row compaction); swaps change only same-length active K/V span; all remaining canonical host bytes identical

frame.routing: RT1 source retained; diagnostic controlled picks after chronological feed

lead_predictions.P1: same_payload AND sham KL < 0.05 nats jointly on >=18/20 snapshots
lead_predictions.P2: remove-source KL > 1 nat on >=6/8 observed-correct, correct-mount cases
lead_predictions.P3: decoy mass high on >=4/6 observed-decoy cases AND lesion classifier strictly better exact-error accuracy than mass classifier on those six

rails.kill: controls comparable to factual interventions (max(same,sham,zero) >= max(remove,swap) with factual max>=0.05 on >=3/20) OR no strict overall accuracy improvement; no serving change
rails.retry: none; failed or abandoned starts remain consumed; resume only never-started cells

scoring.error: casefold+outer-whitespace exact whole answer differs from every expected value; refusals count as factual errors
scoring.kl: KL(P_unforked || P_fork), float64 log-softmax over full vocabulary, natural log; no clipping
scoring.lesion_error_classifier: remove KL > 1.0; fixed positive association, no label-dependent inversion
scoring.mass_caveat: D-NGH threshold carried from TWO full-mount calibration turns; applied to target mount here, never refit.
scoring.mass_statistic: unforked first-position mean over full-attention layers and heads, target span only; D-NGH arithmetic
scoring.metric: paired accuracy (#correct predictions / N); P3 decoy subset, primary overall20 also reported; ties fail improvement
scoring.refusal: normalized answer starts with not in memory, i don't know, i do not know, i cannot, i can't, or unknown
scoring.table: 4 cells on all20 unforked target mass vs remove KL; count, exact_errors, error_rate; empty cells null, never zero
scoring.token_position: first predicted token after the identical full question prefill, no teacher forcing
scoring.truncation: ngen=40, no stop reached => truncated; prediction gates unevaluable (RED), keep rows

seat_predictions.Q1: same_payload raw first-token logits bitwise equal on 20/20; sham KL <0.05 on >=18/20
seat_predictions.Q2: remove-source KL >1 on <=5/8 correct-mount cases (first-token statistic may miss later value tokens)
seat_predictions.Q3: lesion classifier accuracy <= mass classifier accuracy across all 20; reliance alone does not identify truth
